title: Replicating Noise Injection Sandbagging Detection Across Model Families

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible with gap: if noise injection generalizes, it becomes a standard evaluation tool. But this is primarily about validating an existing technique's robustness rather than revealing a new safety concern.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Intermediate: noise injection is conceptually simple but requires setting up prompted and fine-tuned sandbagging across 3 model families with MMLU and HumanEval evaluation. Fine-tuned sandbagging adds training complexity.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable: noise injection results table across 3 model families with 2 benchmarks. Clear pass/fail metric (does anomalous improvement under noise appear or not).

novelty.reasoning: Largely addressed: the original NeurIPS 2025 paper already validates cross-model generalization as its primary claim, including on Mistral Large 120B.

novelty_assessment.label: largely_addressed
novelty_assessment.reasoning: The original noise injection paper (arXiv:2412.01784, NeurIPS 2025) already conducted cross-model validation, stating: 'Through experiments across various model architectures, sizes, and sandbagging techniques, this distinctive response pattern has been established as a reliable, model-agnostic signal.' They demonstrated effectiveness on Mistral Large 120B among others. The technique is implemented in UK AISI's inspect framework. The core contribution proposed — testing generalization across model families — is the primary claim of the original paper itself.
key_references: Tice & Kreer. Noise Injection Reveals Hidden Capabilities of Sandbagging Language Models. arXiv:2412.01784, NeurIPS 2025.
NeurIPS 2024 workshop: Sandbag Detection through Model Impairment.
Noise Injection Systemically Degrades Large Language Model Safety Guardrails. arXiv:2505.13500, 2025.

Noise injection sandbagging detection.details: Confirmed: arXiv:2412.01784, accepted at NeurIPS 2025. The core technique this idea proposes to replicate.

MMLU and HumanEval benchmarks.details: Standard LLM evaluation benchmarks. Confirmed as relevant evaluation tools.
